notes: 52 native observations, all accepted full-LCD/status key replays. JSON saved directly into project.

LineI retains preceding expression/result rows when a new calculation begins without AC. It scrolls one 14-pixel row at a time to keep the latest four rows, including a partial preceding pair. Exact 17-cell expressions reserve an empty wrapped caret row.

AC clears the visible stack while engine history remains recallable. Up/down history and left/right editing show only the selected expression/result. Starting a fresh expression from a recalled result can stack that selected pair before the new expression.

Each visible older entry keeps the presentation actually shown before the next input. Norm result 18 remains 18 after Fix is selected; the following result is 16.0. Recurring, DMS, scientific notation and negative scientific entries remain formatted independently.

FORMAT updates the current answer without changing preceding rows. Ans continuation keeps prior rows. Error screen replaces history; Back or AC returns the repair draft alone, while another AC clears it. Division-by-zero repair and subsequent stacking measured.

Two historical LineI viewport frames from engineering-prime-boundaries now match with the general history renderer and are promoted into that fixture’s accepted keys. No numeric calibration or pixel masking was added. Long current expressions exceeding four lines and arbitrary complex coordinate histories remain separate.
